notes: SUPERSEDED. Original text: 'Manually curated against include/daObjRc_Dorifu_c.h; the class TU contains real member definitions and one empty destructor definition rather than the legacy C D0 body.' The empty destructor definition is exactly what the promotion removed -- see the FIX note below. What remains true is that the manifest was curated by hand against the header.

SUPERSEDED, in every clause. Original text: 'STRICT PARTIAL-ISOLATION BOUNDARY: D1, InitResources, and CleanupResources are contribution-identical. Compiler-generated D0 calls __cxa_vec_cleanup while the legacy C object names the configured same-address alias __destroy_arr (both arm9 0x0207328c), so symbolic object equivalence is conservatively 3/4 and no partial-link claim is made.' There is no legacy C object any more, and the range is now five functions rather than four.

PROMOTION (superseded by the FIX note below, kept for history). Before the promotion this TU carried a real `daObjRc_Dorifu_c::~daObjRc_Dorifu_c()` member DEFINED OUT OF LINE and verified 4/4 MATCH with objisolate clean -- but with `emission order: 1 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order: [(0, 1)]` and an unhomed `_ZN16daObjRc_Dorifu_cD2Ev` that no ROM address claims, because out-of-line mwccarm 2004/b56 emits the D2/D1/D0 group D0-then-D1 while the cartridge keeps D1 at 0x02111f8c below D0 at 0x0211200c. The promotion PR (#2193) worked around that by replacing both variants with `// @symbol` mangled bodies transcribed from the cartridge with tools/disasm.py, banking the CONVERTED tier's no-raw-offset and no-mangled-refs criteria for those two functions in config/converted-backslide-exceptions.jsonl. That workaround was unnecessary: the D0-before-D1 problem is specific to an out-of-line definition, not the destructor itself.

FIX (read this first). ~daObjRc_Dorifu_c() is now `virtual ~daObjRc_Dorifu_c() {}`, defined INLINE in the class body in include/daObjRc_Dorifu_c.h, declared FIRST (matching the already-landed sibling classes daObjKm1_Dorifu_c and daObjWanwanShutter_c). Defined inline, mwccarm emits D1 then D0 in that order with no D2 at all -- `tools/tubuild.py verify` reports `all 5 function(s) in the expected ROM-ascending section order` and `objisolate check: clean`, and the two hand-transcribed mangled bodies and their private externs are gone, so the two config/converted-backslide-exceptions.jsonl rows for this class's destructor symbols are removed. Declaring the destructor makes it this class's key function: mwccarm now homes _ZTI/_ZTS/_ZTV16daObjRc_Dorifu_c in this TU as genuinely owned `data` (moved out of `compiler_only_output` below), matching config/tu_manifest.d/ov043/daObjKm1_Dorifu_c.json's shape for the same base chain. VPTR BIAS: because this TU now owns the vtable, every vptr store names the symbol with addend +8 (`&_ZTV16daObjRc_Dorifu_c[2]`), past the two-word ABI preamble -- addend 0 was only correct while the vtable was an unhomed vague-linkage passenger.

The 10 remaining compiler_only_output entries are the vague-linkage RTTI passengers of the base chain daObjDorifu_c / dBgActor_c / dActor_c / fBase_c / dBase_c -- their own key functions live elsewhere and are unaffected by this fix.

The inline class-body destructor makes mwccarm emit only D1 then D0 in retail order. return new also emits base D2 helpers; exact compiler-only policy deadstrips those. Inherited RTTI stays deadstrip-data at their canonical homes.

Static initializer folded: the five RcDorifuModelFilePtr handles (files 0x69a/0x69c/0x69e/0x6a0/0x6a2), the five RcDorifuCollisionFilePtr handles (files 0x69b/0x69d/0x69f/0x6a1/0x6a3) and their destructor-registration nodes make mwcc emit __sinit_d_a_obj_rc_dorifu.cpp itself (0x1a8, raw-byte-identical to retail __sinit_ov036_0211279c with the same instruction sequence, literal pool order and relocation sites); the handwritten src/unnamed/ov036/__sinit_ov036_0211279c.c is retired. Definition order is the retail construction order (five models, then five collisions), including the 0x6a0 file ID the compiler keeps as a mov immediate. The @360 node clashed with ov023 and is renamed @370; atdup reports 0 cross-module duplicates. This fold does NOT license the CLPS blocks or the .data table/profile/RTTI/vtable rows beyond what the manifest already claims.
